d:
Every day it feels like something big just changed—another AI tool, another job made obsolete, another headline that makes your future feel uncertain.
In this video, we zoom all the way out. From the foraging age to the AI era, we break down the entire story of work—how it began, how it shaped our identity, and why everything is shifting now faster than ever before.
We dive into anthropology, history, economics, and philosophy to ask: What even is a job? Has it always been like this? And what does it mean to live a meaningful life when machines can do what we do?
